threads.title: MSME business banking growth target
threads.note: Last mentioned Apr 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Kaizad Bharucha
history.quote: So if you also see the pack, which my colleagues have put out, we have grown our business banking, which is mainly representative of our MSME, we've grown at about 20% year-on-year, and that will continue to also be in that range of 18% to 20%, 21%, depending upon, obviously, some of the developments in the economy.

history.speaker: Srinivasan Vaidyanathan
history.quote: We do think that in the longer term that the profit growth should be at or above the balance sheet growth.

synthesis.headline: Management delivers steady revenue growth, but most forward-looking promises remain unverifiable or dropped.

points.text: Annual revenue grew consistently from 128552.0 crore in Mar 2021 to 348615.0 crore in Mar 2026.
Profit after tax steadily improved, reaching 79219.0 crore by Mar 2026.
The MSME business banking growth target of 18-21% was dropped after being unrepeated on subsequent calls.
Operating margins remained negative, standing at -11.6% for Mar 2026 and -5.8% for Sep 2026.

bull.text: Annual revenue scaled significantly, reaching 348615.0 crore in Mar 2026.
Cash from operations improved strongly to 113506.0 crore by Mar 2026.

bear.text: Operating margins remain in negative territory at -11.6% for Mar 2026.
Key strategic targets like the MSME growth goal were dropped.

business.what: HDFC Bank Limited is a financial institution offering a range of banking products and services, including retail and corporate banking, MSME financing, loans, and deposits.
